author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Accordion read at 48px and 384px in both themes: the left panel now shows five short horizontal key lines instead of four cutouts, and the bellows are two hexagon folds with an M-shaped top, W bottom and a centre fold, between the key panel and a plain right panel.
omissions: The left panel's outer (left) edge is omitted: five key lines at the required 8-unit pitch fill the full 32-unit height, so the first and last key lines also form the panel's top and bottom.
lucide_reference: No useful Lucide match; line construction on an 8 pitch.
feedback: The left panel needs five short horizontal lines, not four white rectangular cutouts. The center should be “M”hexagon.
